notes.title: v1.0.24: tons of improvements!
notes.content:
Hello friends,

Today's update brings a huge number of improvements. It's hard to pick any highlights, because there are so many. Gameplay, graphics, sound effects, performance, usability, configurability, stability... there's something in every category! So please enjoy this update, and keep sending us your feedback!

[h2]v1.0.24 changelist:[/h2]
- Improved handling of file errors when saving
- Moved mining gear to separate level
- Fixed layout of save file previews
- Bugfix: don't allow Izzy to jump while sliding under a low ceiling
- Bugfix: allow Izzy to cancel a roll into a jump while wearing the ninja suit
- Bugfix: corrected calculation of z coordinates in 3D Wheel
- Made wind look better
- Bugfix: exit map scroll mode by pressing cancel button
- Bugfix: fixed memory leak
- Optimisations: use less RAM, faster loading
- Added option to show autosave icon
- Added option to show progress while loading
- Added sound effects to 3D Wheel
- Improved menu layout
- Fixed problem with control configuration menus (failed to apply new controls when leaving menu by pressing Esc)
- Made button in Chocolate mine more obvious
- Added more crystals to mine cart level to make it a bit easier
- Fixed bug where rocks were spawned into level but never removed
- Removed "get ready" screen
- Small graphical improvements
- Added backer NPC "Lutz"
- Fixed bug where Izzy can fall through the floor during the final boss fight
- New splash sequence
- Improved scrolling in menus
- Sleeping now also fills spirit bar (because why not)
- Added confirmation before using items in inventory.
- Added some details to final boss fight.
- Fixed bug where bat could get past the crates in Chocolate Mine.
- Fixed bug where bat could get past the ice cubes in East Pole.
- Minor corrections in dialogues.
- East pole: removed two inadvertently wall-jumpable tiles.
- Chocolate Mine: mirrors were missing the option to warp to Borkington.
- Fixed a bug where sometimes missions are displayed with an "X" even when they are not on the map.
- Fixed dialogue balloons for some info signs
- Fixed bug where save state is sometimes not restored correctly
- Added confirmation to consumably items
- Added hand mirror item
- Added sound effects to Minotaur boss fight
- Added sound effects to treasure chests
- Added sound effects to various enemies
- Added sound effects and subtle animations to lift in Chocolate Mine
- Various other new and improved sound effects
- Added button graphics for Xinput controllers
- Fixed blue slime behaviour
- Fixed debris when blowing up rock heaps and walls
- Tweaked some enemies to make them less cheesy

notes.title: v1.0.22: Happy Halloween!
notes.content:
Hello friends,

What is the perfect game to play during Halloween? Well, it's Intrepid Izzy, of course! This game is all about costumes and monsters. And to drive that point home, today's update adds some temporary Halloween decorations. Have fun!

[h2]v1.0.22 changelist:[/h2]
- Added Jack O' Lanterns here and there to celebrate Halloween.
- Changed execution order of physics and entity code to fix an animation bug.
- Bugfix & optimisation for conditional spawning.
- Corrected some textual errors.
- Disabling some (but not all) kill rooms after use.
- Fixed one instance where Izzy could get stuck in Haunted Forest.

notes.title: v1.0.20: upgraded map screen
notes.content:
Hello friends,

Today's update brings various improvements, most notably to the map screen. The objectives below the map can now be scrolled through, which is especially useful on screens with a resolution lower than 1080p. This does mean that a button must be pressed in order to scroll the map, though.

[h2]v1.0.20 changelist:[/h2]
- Map screen: objectives are now selectable and are automatically scrolled to when possible
- Map screen: smoother scrolling
- Map screen: can now be accessed even in levels without a map
- Added more objectives
- Bugfix: sometimes too many falling rocks appeared in Chocolate Mine
- Bugfix: position of objects with persistent position sometimes wasn't saved
- Bugfix: gliding onto a spring with the squirrel suit broke gravity
- The game now automatically pauses when window focus is lost
- Small changes to various levels and dialogues

notes.title: Update v1.0.19
notes.content:
Hello friends,

This is not the first update to Intrepid Izzy, but it is the first one with an annoucement and a changelog!

[h3]v1.0.19[/h3]
- The version number is now displayed on the title screen.
- Keyboard controls: Enter no longer pauses the game, only Esc does. Enter can now be used to confirm dialogues.
- Removed "Game Over" screen.
- Fixed a bug where objectives could re-appear after previously being completed.
- Fixed location in East Pole where Izzy could get stuck while wearing the vampire suit.
- Fixed save slot preview image for Temple of Nuts.
- Added dotted lines between connected doors on the map.
- The Leviathan now has some defense against the vampire special, so the fight isn't over too quickly.
- Added crates to the uppercut tutorial in Blobby Blob Dungeon, to make sure it can't be inadvertently skipped.
- Bullets in "Plerg!" have a slightly larger hitbox now, which should make the game feel more intuitive/fair.
- A new NPC in the Chocolate Mine provides hints about garlic and the helmet.
- Many other small changes in various levels.

[h3]Earlier updates[/h3]
- F,F+A move is disabled by default, because for some players it happened by accident.
- Fixed crash bug when opening the map screen.
- Fixed several places in levels where Izzy could get stuck.
- Fixed sound bug.
